test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option which can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. In case Options A, B and C are not found suitable, choose Option D: “No Improvement Required.”

The principal stated that the proposed plan was __in accordance to the guidelines__ issued by the education department.
solution:
The correct answer is '**in accordance with the guidelines**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The phrase **"in accordance with"** is the correct usage and is commonly used to refer to compliance or agreement with a set of rules, regulations, or guidelines.
 
• The given sentence uses the incorrect phrase **"in accordance to"**, which is grammatically wrong.
 
• **Option 2: "in accordance for"** is incorrect because the preposition "for" does not fit the required grammatical structure.
 
• **Option 3: "in accordance on"** is incorrect because "on" is not appropriate in this context.
 
• **Option 4: "No improvement required"** is incorrect because the existing sentence needs improvement.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"The principal stated that the proposed plan was **in accordance with the guidelines**__ issued by the education department."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "in accordance for"** is grammatically incorrect because "for" does not work with "accordance" in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "in accordance on"** is grammatically incorrect because "on" is not suitable with "accordance" here.
 
• **Option 4: No improvement required** is incorrect because the phrase "in accordance to" is wrong and needs to be replaced.
